name: Automation Lab
about: The layers of ARCHITECTURE.md, bottom first. The core knows the laws and numerics and nothing of the page; the kit draws and knows no law; each lab joins the two for one equation; the app groups the labs under their chapters and lays out the page.

layers.name: core
layers.why: LTI numerics (polynomials, transfer functions, matrices, integrators), the laws of both courses and units, pure

layers.name: kit
layers.why: Controls, readouts, charts, field maps and card drawings every lab draws with

layers.name: labs
layers.why: One idea each: a system to play with, its equations and its practice

layers.name: app
layers.why: Reads labs.json, lays out the chapters with their labs, and the theme
